# 3D Deep-Sim Studio Engine & Harness Compact API Sheet (`studio/llms.txt`)
#
# Borrowed from the VibeGame `llms.txt` pattern: Agents MUST read this compact
# API sheet instead of scanning full engine/harness source files.

## 1. Studio Harness CLI Commands
- `node harness/agents.mjs [list | show <id> | create <id> <Title> | json]`
  Loads all roles from `studio/roles/**/*.md` (5 default + unlimited custom roles/swarms) and presets from `studio/presets/*.md`.
- `node harness/route.mjs [--role <id>] [--prompt "..."] [--dry-run] [--status]`
  Executes `freecc:auto` multi-model failover routing across Vertex Gemini, NVIDIA NIM, Groq, OpenRouter, xAI Grok, Anthropic, OpenAI, and Ollama with 30s+ cooldowns in `.studio/cooldowns.json`.
- `node harness/task.mjs [next | list | start <ID> | done <ID> | add "<Title>" --role <role> --priority P0..P3]`
  Manages `studio/NEXT.md` and synchronizes `studio/CURRENT_TASK.md`.
- `node harness/event.mjs --type <event.type> --agent <role> [--task <ID>] --msg "<summary>"`
  Appends a zero-token telemetry line to `.studio/events.jsonl` and `/tmp/agent-events.jsonl`.
- `node harness/status.mjs [--json]`
  Prints a 0-token studio snapshot combining queue, router matrix, and recent events.
- `node hub/server.mjs`
  Starts the Zero-Token Passive Workflow UI HUB (`http://127.0.0.1:4177` Desktop 4-Quadrant War Room; `?view=mobile` Mobile Command Feed).
- `node qa/playtest.mjs [--stage 1|2] [--seed 1337] [--ticks 200] [--url http://127.0.0.1:5173/?playtest=1]`
  Runs Stage 1 programmatic trajectory QA + Stage 2 Playwright accessibility/UISentinel layout QA and writes reports to `qa/reports/`.
- `node scripts/check-sim-purity.mjs`
  Verifies zero DOM, Three.js, `Math.random()`, or `Date.now()` leaks in `src/sim/` or `cartridges/*/sim/`.

## 2. Simulation Cartridge Contract (`qa/sim.adapter.mjs` & `window.__sim`)
Every 3D simulation cartridge mounted in this studio exposes a pure-TypeScript core:
- `init(seed: number): SimState` — Creates a deterministic initial state with seeded `sfc32` RNG array `[a, b, c, d]`.
- `step(ticks?: number): SimState` — Advances fixed-timestep simulation by integer ticks.
- `dispatch(action: Action): { ok: boolean, reason?: string }` — Applies a serializable command at a tick boundary.
- `getState(): SimState` — Returns plain JSON state (numbers, strings, booleans, arrays, plain objects only).
- `serialize(): string` / `deserialize(json: string): SimState` — Lossless save/load round-trip.
- `getHash(): string` — Canonical quantized 32-bit FNV-1a state hash for cross-engine port verification.
- `invariants(state: SimState): Violation[]` — Returns P0/P1/P2 invariant violations (e.g., NaN, negative resources, stranded units).
